name: Convent of Christ in Tomar
description: Perched on a hill above the town of Tomar in central Portugal, this vast complex began in the 12th century as a Templar stronghold. After the Templars were dissolved, it passed to the Order of Christ, which backed Portugal's voyages of discovery. Its fortress walls and ornate Manueline additions show a shift from crusading castle to a building open to the wider world.
